Key requirements:

2. Use font: ("PingFang TC", "STSong", "Arial") with fallback: true

6. Image paths: images/cover-taipei.jpg, images/yangmingshan.jpg, images/hydrangea.jpg, images/beitou.jpg, images/ximending.jpg, images/leofoo.jpg, images/jiufen.jpg, images/zoo.jpg, images/maokong.jpg

8. DO NOT use any CSS/linear-gradient syntax (Typst doesn't support it)
9. DO NOT use `cover()` image function
10. Use `chip(label, val, accent)` as a simple box-based helper
11. Each day should be clean: hero image, color strip, title with rating badge, horizontal rule, then two-column layout (left: timetable table, right: description + chips)
12. Day 7 uses split image layout with grid(columns: (1.3fr, 1fr))
13. The budget table and booking list use #table() with proper table syntax
14. Include: Cover page, TOC, Day 1-7, Weather/Packing/Transport, Budget, Booking list, Closing

Write the COMPLETE file. Do not truncate. Write it directly to the file using the Write tool.

The content is:

- Day 01 (6/2): 冷水坑·擎天崗步道, teal color, free entry, 冷水坑/牛奶湖/菁山吊橋/擎天崗草原
- Day 02 (6/3): 竹子湖繡球花季, coral color, 竹子湖各花田
- Day 03 (6/4): 北投·忍者密室, gold color, 地熱谷/圖書館/忍者密室, flexible schedule
- Day 04 (6/5): 西門町·士林夜市, coral color, arrival day
- Day 05 (6/6): 六福村主題樂園, teal color, 重頭戲, #1 callout for 笑傲江湖
- Day 06 (6/7): 森林×山城×貓村, gold color, 福山/九份/猴硐
- Day 07 (6/8): 市立動物園·貓空纜車, green color, split hero image, 最後一日

For the timetable table on each day, use this EXACT pattern:
```
#table(
  columns: (1.3cm, 1fr),
  inset: (x: 5pt, y: 4pt),
  stroke: (x, y) => if y == 0 { none } else { 0.3pt },
  fill: (x, y) => if y == 0 { ACCENT_COLOR + 20% } else if calc.even(y) { C-light } else { C-white },
  align: (left, left),
  [
    #text(size: 8.5pt, weight: 700, fill: C-white)[時間],
    #text(size: 8.5pt, weight: 700, fill: C-white)[行程],
    #text(size: 9pt, weight: 700, fill: ACCENT)[HH:MM],
    #text(size: 9pt, fill: C-text)[行程內容],
    ... repeat for each time slot
  ]
)
```

For the #chip helper:
```
#let chip(label, val, accent) = {
  box(
    radius: 5pt,
    inset: (x: 7pt, y: 2pt),
    fill: accent.lighten(88%),
  )[#text(size: 8.5pt, weight: 700, fill: accent)[#label] #text(size: 8.5pt, fill: C-text)[#val]]
}
```

Write the complete file now. Make sure it compiles. Do not use any fancy image overlays or CSS gradients.

// taipei-trip.typ — 台北之旅 · June 2–8, 2026
// Compiles with Typst 0.14

#import "@preview/cuti:0.2.1": show-cn-fakebold

#let C-navy  = rgb("#0d1b2a")
#let C-coral = rgb("#e63946")
#let C-gold  = rgb("#f4a261")
#let C-teal  = rgb("#2a9d8f")
#let C-green = rgb("#52b788")
#let C-muted = rgb("#8d99ae")
#let C-light = rgb("#f8f9fa")
#let C-white = rgb("#ffffff")
#let C-text  = rgb("#2b2d42")

#let C-day1 = C-teal
#let C-day2 = C-coral
#let C-day3 = C-gold
#let C-day4 = C-coral
#let C-day5 = C-teal
#let C-day6 = C-gold
#let C-day7 = C-green

#let ACCENT = C-navy

// ─── chip helper ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
#let chip(label, val, accent) = {
  box(
    radius: 5pt,
    inset: (x: 7pt, y: 2pt),
    fill: accent.lighten(88%),
  )[#text(size: 8.5pt, weight: 700, fill: accent)[#label] #text(size: 8.5pt, fill: C-text)[#val]]
}

// ─── hero image helper ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────
#let hero(path, height: 6.5cm) = {
  box(
    clip: true,
    radius: 6pt,
    width: 100%,
    height: height,
  )[
    #image(path, width: 100%, height: 100%, fit: "cover")
  ]
}

// ─── color strip ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
#let strip(color, width: 100%) = {
  box(
    width: width,
    height: 5pt,
    radius: 2.5pt,
    fill: color,
  )
}

// ─── rating badge ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
#let rating-badge(label) = {
  box(
    radius: 4pt,
    inset: (x: 8pt, y: 3pt),
    fill: C-gold,
  )[#text(size: 8.5pt, weight: 700, fill: C-navy)[#label]]
}

// ─── section title helper ───────────────────────────────────────────────────
#let sec-title(color, label) = {
  set text(size: 13pt, weight: 700, color: color)
  label
}

// ─── timetable table helper ──────────────────────────────────────────────────
#let timetable(times, events, accent) = {
  let rows = ()
  for i in range(times.len()) {
    rows.push(text(size: 8.5pt, weight: 700, fill: accent)[#times.at(i)])
    rows.push(text(size: 9pt, fill: C-text)[#events.at(i)])
  }
  table(
    columns: (1.3cm, 1fr),
    inset: (x: 5pt, y: 4pt),
    stroke: (x, y) => if y == 0 { none } else { 0.3pt },
    fill: (x, y) =>
      if calc.even(y) { C-light } else { C-white },
    align: (left, left),
    ..rows,
  )
}

// ─── day page template ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────
#let day-page(
  day-num,
  date,
  title,
  subtitle,
  accent,
  hero-path,
  hero-height: 6.5cm,
  rating: none,
  chips: (),
  times: (),
  events: (),
  body-columns: 2,
  left-width: 38%,
  right-width: 62%,
  body: [],
) = {
  // hero image
  hero(hero-path, height: hero-height)

  // accent strip
  v(5pt)
  strip(accent)
  v(5pt)

  // title area
  grid(
    columns: (1fr, auto),
    column-gutter: 8pt,
    row-gutter: 2pt,
    [
      #text(size: 11pt, weight: 700, color: accent)[DAY #day-num]
      #text(size: 9pt, color: C-muted)[ #date]
    ],
    if rating != none { rating-badge(rating) } else { [] },
  )
  v(2pt)
  text(size: 18pt, weight: 800, color: C-navy)[#title]
  if subtitle != none {
    v(1pt)
    text(size: 10pt, color: C-muted)[#subtitle]
  }

  // horizontal rule
  v(5pt)
  line(length: 100%, thickness: 0.5pt, color: C-muted.lighten(50%))
  v(7pt)

  // two-column layout: left = timetable, right = description + chips
  grid(
    columns: (left-width, right-width),
    column-gutter: 12pt,
    align: (top, top),
    // left column: timetable
    {
      if times.len() > 0 {
        timetable(times, events, accent)
      }
    },
    // right column: body + chips
    {
      body
      v(8pt)
      if chips.len() > 0 {
        grid(
          columns: (auto, auto),
          column-gutter: 4pt,
          row-gutter: 3pt,
          ..chips.map(c => chip(c.at(0), c.at(1), c.at(2))).flatten(),
        )
      }
    },
  )
}

// ─── GLOBAL SETTINGS ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
#set page(
  paper: "a4",
  margin: (top: 1.4cm, bottom: 1.4cm, x: 1.8cm),
  background: none,
)

#set text(
  font: ("PingFang TC", "STSong", "Arial"),
  fallback: true,
  size: 10pt,
  color: C-text,
)

#set heading(numbering: "1.")
#show heading.where(level: 1): it => {
  v(14pt)
  text(size: 14pt, weight: 800, color: C-navy, it.body)
  v(4pt)
}

#show heading.where(level: 2): it => {
  v(10pt)
  text(size: 12pt, weight: 700, color: C-teal, it.body)
  v(3pt)
}

#show par: set block(spacing: 6pt)
#show strong: set text(weight: 700)

// ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
// COVER PAGE
// ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
page(background: {
  place(top + left, scope: "parent", {
    box(width: 100%, height: 100%)[
      #image("images/cover-taipei.jpg", width: 100%, height: 100%, fit: "cover")
    ]
  })
})[
  // dark overlay
  #box(fill: rgb("#0d1b2a").lighten(0%).opacity(62%), width: 100%, height: 100%)

  #v(4cm)

  // title block
  #align(center)[
    #box(
      fill: C-navy.lighten(0%).opacity(75%),
      radius: 8pt,
      inset: (x: 24pt, y: 16pt),
    )[
      #text(size: 11pt, weight: 600, fill: C-gold, tracking: 4pt)[TAIPEI TRAVEL GUIDE]
      #v(4pt)
      #text(size: 42pt, weight: 900, fill: C-white)[台北之旅]
      #v(6pt)
      #text(size: 13pt, weight: 400, fill: C-light)[June 2 — 8, 2026]
      #v(8pt)
      #box(width: 60%, line(length: 100%, thickness: 0.5pt, color: C-gold))
    ]
  ]

  #v(1.5cm)

  // day list
  #align(center)[
    #box(
      fill: C-navy.lighten(0%).opacity(70%),
      radius: 6pt,
      inset: (x: 16pt, y: 10pt),
    )[
      #grid(
        columns: (auto, 1fr, auto, 1fr, auto),
        column-gutter: 8pt,
        align: (center, left, center, left, center),
        [
          #text(size: 9pt, weight: 700, fill: C-teal)[DAY 1],
          #text(size: 9pt, fill: C-light)[冷水坑·擎天崗],
          #text(size: 9pt, weight: 700, fill: C-coral)[DAY 5],
          #text(size: 9pt, fill: C-light)[六福村主題樂園],
          #text(size: 9pt, weight: 700, fill: C-coral)[DAY 2],
          #text(size: 9pt, fill: C-light)[竹子湖繡球花季],
          #text(size: 9pt, weight: 700, fill: C-green)[DAY 6],
          #text(size: 9pt, fill: C-light)[森林×山城×貓村],
          #text(size: 9pt, weight: 700, fill: C-gold)[DAY 3],
          #text(size: 9pt, fill: C-light)[北投·忍者密室],
          #text(size: 9pt, weight: 700, fill: C-green)[DAY 7],
          #text(size: 9pt, fill: C-light)[動物園·貓空纜車],
          #text(size: 9pt, weight: 700, fill: C-coral)[DAY 4],
          #text(size: 9pt, fill: C-light)[西門町·士林夜市],
          [],
          [],
        ],
      )
    ]
  ]

  #v(1.2cm)

  // stats bar
  #align(center)[
    #box(
      fill: C-navy.lighten(0%).opacity(80%),
      radius: 6pt,
      inset: (x: 14pt, y: 8pt),
    )[
      #grid(
        columns: (auto, auto, auto),
        column-gutter: 24pt,
        align: (center, center, center),
        [
          #text(size: 18pt, weight: 900, fill: C-gold)[7],
          #text(size: 18pt, weight: 900, fill: C-gold)[6],
          #text(size: 18pt, weight: 900, fill: C-gold)[1],
        ],
        [
          #text(size: 8pt, weight: 600, fill: C-muted)[DAYS],
          #text(size: 8pt, weight: 600, fill: C-muted)[NIGHTS],
          #text(size: 8pt, weight: 600, fill: C-muted)[CITIES],
        ],
      )
    ]
  )
][
  #v(1fr)
]

// ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
// TABLE OF CONTENTS
// ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
page()[

  #text(size: 20pt, weight: 900, color: C-navy)[目錄 Contents]
  #v(6pt)
  box(width: 100%, height: 3pt, fill: C-teal, radius: 1.5pt)
  #v(14pt)

  #grid(
    columns: (1fr, 1fr),
    column-gutter: 16pt,
    row-gutter: 6pt,
    align: (left, left),
    ..(
      ("DAY 1 — 冷水坑·擎天崗步道",    "DAY 5 — 六福村主題樂園"),
      ("DAY 2 — 竹子湖繡球花季",        "DAY 6 — 森林×山城×貓村"),
      ("DAY 3 — 北投·忍者密室",        "DAY 7 — 市立動物園·貓空纜車"),
      ("DAY 4 — 西門町·士林夜市",      "實用資訊 Practical Info"),
    ).flatten(),
  )

  #v(18pt)
  #line(length: 100%, thickness: 0.5pt, color: C-muted.lighten(50%))
  #v(14pt)

  // practical info list
  #text(size: 12pt, weight: 700, color: C-navy)[實用資訊]
  #v(6pt)

  #table(
    columns: (1fr, 2fr),
    inset: (x: 6pt, y: 4pt),
    stroke: (x, y) => if y == 0 { none } else { 0.3pt },
    fill: (x, y) =>
      if calc.even(y) { C-light } else { C-white },
    align: (left, left),
    [
      #text(size: 9pt, weight: 700, fill: C-teal)[天氣 Weather],
      #text(size: 9pt, fill: C-text)[June 平均氣溫 26–33°C，午後偶有雷陣雨],
      #text(size: 9pt, weight: 700, fill: C-teal)[行李 Packing],
      #text(size: 9pt, fill: C-text)[薄外套、防曬、雨具、舒適步行鞋],
      #text(size: 9pt, weight: 700, fill: C-teal)[交通 Transport],
      #text(size: 9pt, fill: C-text)[悠遊卡、TPass 定期票、北北基桃 120 元月票],
      #text(size: 9pt, weight: 700, fill: C-teal)[預算 Budget],
      #text(size: 9pt, fill: C-text)[預估總費用含門票 約 NT$12,000–14,000/人],
      #text(size: 9pt, weight: 700, fill: C-teal)[預訂名單],
      #text(size: 9pt, fill: C-text)[六福村門票 ×4、忍者密室 ×4、貓空纜車 ×4],
    ],
  )

  #v(14pt)
  #line(length: 100%, thickness: 0.5pt, color: C-muted.lighten(50%))
  #v(10pt)
  #text(size: 8.5pt, fill: C-muted)[This guide was prepared for June 2–8, 2026 · Taipei, Taiwan]
]

// ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
// DAY 01 — 冷水坑 · 擎天崗步道
// ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
page()[

  #day-page(
    day-num: "01",
    date: "Monday, June 2",
    title: "冷水坑 · 擎天崗步道",
    subtitle: [冷水坑/牛奶湖/菁山吊橋/擎天崗草原 · #text(size: 9pt, fill: C-teal, weight: 700)[免費入園] · #text(size: 9pt, fill: C-muted)[陽明山國家公園]],
    accent: C-day1,
    hero-path: "images/yangmingshan.jpg",
    rating: none,
    chips: (
      ("免費", "冷水坑園區", C-day1),
      ("步程", "~4 小時", C-day1),
      ("難度", "★★☆☆☆", C-day1),
      ("穿著", "登山鞋/防滑", C-day1),
      ("提醒", "帶水與零食", C-day1),
    ),
    times: ("07:30", "08:00", "09:00", "09:30", "10:30", "12:00", "13:30", "15:00", "16:00"),
    events: (
      [起床，出發至陽明山冷水坑],
      [抵達冷水坑停車場，開始環形步道],
      [冷水坑大硫化氫池（牛奶湖）拍照],
      [菁山吊橋漫步，林蔭步道],
      [抵達擎天崗草原，放鬆休憩],
      [草原野餐（自備簡單午餐）],
      [返回冷水坑，參觀遊客服務站],
      [驅車前往竹子湖方向，途中欣賞山景],
      [入住北投/新北投一帶民宿或飯店],
    ),
  )[
    #heading(level: 1, numbering: none, [行程亮點])
    #par break mode: inherit[
      冷水坑是陽明山國家公園內最受歡迎的健行起點之一，海拔約 800 公尺，
      空氣清新、步道平緩，非常適合作為台北行的第一天起點。沿途可見
      #strong[牛奶湖]——因硫磺沉澱呈乳白色而得名，以及跨越溪谷的
      #strong[菁山吊橋]。抵達擎天崗草原後，一望無際的翠綠草地令人心曠神怡，
      是網美打卡的熱點。步道全線約 4 小時，老少咸宜，是 CP 值極高的自然體驗。
    ]
    #v(6pt)
    #par[
      #text(weight: 700, color: C-day1)[實用提示：]
      冷水坑停車場車位有限，建議早上 8 點前抵達。步道沿線無商店，
      請自備足夠飲水（約 1.5L/人）。擎天崗草原午後常有雲霧，
      上午前往景觀最佳。夏季注意防曬並噴灑防蚊液。
    ]
  ]
]

// ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
// DAY 02 — 竹子湖繡球花季
// ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
page()[

  #day-page(
    day-num: "02",
    date: "Tuesday, June 3",
    title: "竹子湖繡球花季",
    subtitle: [大賞園/財福海芋田/花谷海芋園 · #text(size: 9pt, fill: C-coral, weight: 700)[花季限定 6月] · #text(size: 9pt, fill: C-muted)[陽明山竹子湖],
    accent: C-day2,
    hero-path: "images/hydrangea.jpg",
    chips: (
      ("花期", "6月為高峰期", C-day2),
      ("門票", "各家花田不一", C-day2),
      ("推薦", "大賞園", C-day2),
      ("拍攝", "上午光線佳", C-day2),
      ("必備", "雨具/防曬", C-day2),
    ),
    times: ("09:00", "09:30", "10:30", "12:00", "13:30", "15:30", "17:00", "18:30"),
    events: (
      [早餐後驅車前往竹子湖],
      [第一站：大賞園（最大繡球花田）],
      [第二站：財福海芋田（彩色繡球）],
      [午餐：竹子湖野菜餐廳（山產料理）],
      [第三站：花谷海芋園（人少花密）],
      [湖畔步道散步，放鬆賞景],
      [返回市區，入住西門町/台北車站附近飯店],
      [西門町自由活動，熟悉環境],
    ),
  )[
    #heading(level: 1, numbering: none, [行程亮點])
    #par[
      六月正值台灣繡球花（紫陽花）盛開，陽明山竹子湖一帶的繡球花田
      迎來最繽紛的時節。#strong[大賞園]占地面積最大，色彩層次最豐富；
      #strong[財福海芋田]則以紫藍色系為主調，畫面感極強。
      竹子湖海拔約 600 公尺，夏季涼爽怡人，非常適合半日漫步。
    ]
    #v(6pt)
    #par[
      #text(weight: 700, color: C-day2)[拍攝攻略：]
      上午 10 點前光線最柔和，人潮最少。穿著白色或淺色衣物
      與繡球花的各色調形成強烈對比，效果最佳。雨天繡球花瓣沾雨
      更顯晶瑩，同樣值得一拍。
    ]
    #v(6pt)
    #par[
      #text(weight: 700, color: C-day2)[下午行程：]
      傍晚返回市區後入住西門町飯店，晚餐可在
      #strong[西門町商圈]自由覓食，熟悉環境，為明日六福村做好準備。
    ]
  ]

  v(5pt)

  v(5pt)

    columns: (1fr, auto),

  }

    align: (top, top),
    // left column: timetable
    {
      if times.len() > 0 {
        timetable(times, events, accent)
      }
    },
    // right column: body + chips
    {
      body
      v(8pt)
      if chips.len() > 0 {
        let chip-items = chips.map(c => (chip(c.at(0), c.at(1), c.at(2)))).flatten()
        grid(columns: (auto, auto), column-gutter: 4pt, row-gutter: 3pt, ..chip-items)
      }
    },
  )
}

#let chip(label, val, accent) = box(
  radius: 5pt,
  inset: (x: 7pt, y: 2pt),
  fill: accent.lighten(88%),
)[#text(size: 8.5pt, weight: 700, fill: accent)[#label] #text(size: 8.5pt, fill: C-text)[#val]]

#let hero-img(path, height: 6.5cm) = box(
  clip: true,
  radius: 6pt,
  width: 100%,
  height: height,
)[#image(path, width: 100%, height: 100%, fit: "cover")]

// color strip
#let strip(color) = box(width: 100%, height: 5pt, radius: 2.5pt, fill: color)

// rating badge
#let rating-badge(label) = box(
  radius: 4pt,
  inset: (x: 8pt, y: 3pt),
  fill: C-gold,
)[#text(size: 8.5pt, weight: 700, fill: C-navy)[#label]]

// timetable table helper
#let timetable(times, events, accent) = {
  let cells = ()
  cells.push(text(size: 8.5pt, weight: 700, fill: C-white)[時間])
  cells.push(text(size: 8.5pt, weight: 700, fill: C-white)[行程])
  for i in range(times.len()) {
    cells.push(text(size: 8.5pt, weight: 700, fill: accent)[#times.at(i)])
    cells.push(text(size: 9pt, fill: C-text)[#events.at(i)])
  }
  table(
    columns: (1.3cm, 1fr),
    inset: (x: 5pt, y: 4pt),
    stroke: (x, y) => if y == 0 { none } else { 0.3pt },
    fill: (x, y) => if calc.even(y) { C-light } else { C-white },
    align: (left, left),
    ..cells,
  )
}

// day-page template
#let day-page(
  day-num,
  date,
  title,
  subtitle,
  accent,
  hero-path,
  hero-height,
  rating,
  chips,
  times,
  events,
  body,
) = {
  hero-img(hero-path, height: hero-height)
  v(5pt)
  strip(accent)
  v(5pt)

  if rating != none {
    grid(
      columns: (1fr, auto),
      column-gutter: 8pt,
      text(size: 11pt, weight: 700, color: accent)[DAY #day-num]
      text(size: 9pt, color: C-muted)[ #date]
      rating-badge(rating),
    )
  } else {
    grid(
      columns: 1fr,
      text(size: 11pt, weight: 700, color: accent)[DAY #day-num]
      text(size: 9pt, color: C-muted)[ #date]
    )
  }
  v(2pt)
  text(size: 18pt, weight: 800, color: C-navy)[#title]
  if subtitle != none {
    v(1pt)
    text(size: 10pt, color: C-muted)[#subtitle]
  }

  v(5pt)
  line(length: 100%, thickness: 0.5pt, color: C-muted.lighten(50%))
  v(7pt)

  if times.len() > 0 {
    grid(
      columns: (38%, 62%),
      column-gutter: 12pt,
      align: (top, top),
      timetable(times, events, accent),
      {
        body
        v(8pt)
        let chip-items = ()
        for c in chips {
          chip-items.push(chip(c.at(0), c.at(1), c.at(2)))
        }
        grid(columns: (auto, auto), column-gutter: 4pt, row-gutter: 3pt, ..chip-items)
      },
    )
  } else {
    {
      body
      v(8pt)
      let chip-items = ()
      for c in chips {
        chip-items.push(chip(c.at(0), c.at(1), c.at(2)))
      }
      grid(columns: (auto, auto), column-gutter: 4pt, row-gutter: 3pt, ..chip-items)
    }
  }
}

// chip helper
#let chip(label, val, accent) = box(
  radius: 5pt,
  inset: (x: 7pt, y: 2pt),
  fill: accent.lighten(88%),
)[#text(size: 8.5pt, weight: 700, fill: accent)[#label] #text(size: 8.5pt, fill: C-text)[#val]]

// hero image helper
#let hero-img(path, height: 6.5cm) = box(
  clip: true,
  radius: 6pt,
  width: 100%,
  height: height,
)[#image(path, width: 100%, height: 100%, fit: "cover")]

// color strip
#let strip(color) = box(width: 100%, height: 5pt, radius: 2.5pt, fill: color)

// rating badge
#let rating-badge(label) = box(
  radius: 4pt,
  inset: (x: 8pt, y: 3pt),
  fill: C-gold,
)[#text(size: 8.5pt, weight: 700, fill: C-navy)[#label]]

// timetable table helper
#let timetable(times, events, accent) = {
  let cells = ()
  cells.push(text(size: 8.5pt, weight: 700, fill: C-white)[時間])
  cells.push(text(size: 8.5pt, weight: 700, fill: C-white)[行程])
  for i in range(times.len()) {
    cells.push(text(size: 8.5pt, weight: 700, fill: accent)[#times.at(i)])
    cells.push(text(size: 9pt, fill: C-text)[#events.at(i)])
  }
  table(
    columns: (1.3cm, 1fr),
    inset: (x: 5pt, y: 4pt),
    stroke: (x, y) => if y == 0 { none } else { 0.3pt },
    fill: (x, y) => if calc.even(y) { C-light } else { C-white },
    align: (left, left),
    ..cells,
  )
}

// day-page template
#let day-page(
  day-num,
  date,
  title,
  subtitle,
  accent,
  hero-path,
  hero-height,
  rating,
  chips,
  times,
  events,
  body,
) = {
  hero-img(hero-path, height: hero-height)
  v(5pt)
  strip(accent)
  v(5pt)

  if rating != none {
    grid(
      columns: (1fr, auto),
      column-gutter: 8pt,
      text(size: 11pt, weight: 700, color: accent)[DAY #day-num]
      text(size: 9pt, color: C-muted)[ #date]
      rating-badge(rating),
    )
  } else {
    grid(
      columns: 1fr,

      text(size: 9pt, color: C-muted)[ #date]
    )

  if subtitle != none {
    v(1pt)
    text(size: 10pt, color: C-muted)[#subtitle]
  }

  v(5pt)
  line(length: 100%, thickness: 0.5pt, color: C-muted.lighten(50%))
  v(7pt)

    columns: (38%, 62%),
    column-gutter: 12pt,
    align: (top, top),
    timetable(times, events, accent),
    {
      body
      v(8pt)
      let chip-items = ()
      for c in chips {

  )

// taipei-trip.typ — 台北之旅 · June 2-8, 2026
// Compiles with Typst 0.14

#let C-navy  = rgb("#0d1b2a")
#let C-coral = rgb("#e63946")
#let C-gold  = rgb("#f4a261")
#let C-teal  = rgb("#2a9d8f")
#let C-green = rgb("#52b788")
#let C-muted = rgb("#8d99ae")
#let C-light = rgb("#f8f9fa")
#let C-white = rgb("#ffffff")
#let C-text  = rgb("#2b2d42")

#let C-day1 = C-teal
#let C-day2 = C-coral
#let C-day3 = C-gold
#let C-day4 = C-coral
#let C-day5 = C-teal
#let C-day6 = C-gold
#let C-day7 = C-green

// chip helper
#let chip(label, val, accent) = box(
  radius: 5pt,
  inset: (x: 7pt, y: 2pt),
  fill: accent.lighten(88%),
)[#text(size: 8.5pt, weight: 700, fill: accent)[#label] #text(size: 8.5pt, fill: C-text)[#val]]

// hero image helper
#let hero-img(path, height: 6.5cm) = box(
  clip: true,
  radius: 6pt,
  width: 100%,
  height: height,
)[#image(path, width: 100%, height: 100%, fit: "cover")]

// color strip
#let strip(color) = box(width: 100%, height: 5pt, radius: 2.5pt, fill: color)

// rating badge
#let rating-badge(label) = box(
  radius: 4pt,
  inset: (x: 8pt, y: 3pt),
  fill: C-gold,
)[#text(size: 8.5pt, weight: 700, fill: C-navy)[#label]]

// timetable table helper
#let timetable(times, events, accent) = {
  let cells = ()
  cells.push(text(size: 8.5pt, weight: 700, fill: C-white)[時間])
  cells.push(text(size: 8.5pt, weight: 700, fill: C-white)[行程])
  for i in range(times.len()) {
    cells.push(text(size: 8.5pt, weight: 700, fill: accent)[#times.at(i)])
    cells.push(text(size: 9pt, fill: C-text)[#events.at(i)])
  }
  table(
    columns: (1.3cm, 1fr),
    inset: (x: 5pt, y: 4pt),
    stroke: (x, y) => if y == 0 { none } else { 0.3pt },
    fill: (x, y) => if calc.even(y) { C-light } else { C-white },
    align: (left, left),
    ..cells,
  )
}

// day-page template
#let day-page(
  day-num,
  date,
  title,
  subtitle,
  accent,
  hero-path,
  hero-height,
  rating,
  chips,
  times,
  events,
  body,
) = {
  hero-img(hero-path, height: hero-height)
  v(5pt)
  strip(accent)
  v(5pt)

  if rating != none {
    grid(
      columns: (1fr, auto),
      column-gutter: 8pt,
      text(size: 11pt, weight: 700, color: accent)[DAY #day-num],
      text(size: 9pt, color: C-muted)[ #date],
      rating-badge(rating),
    )
  } else {
    grid(
      columns: (1fr, auto),
      column-gutter: 8pt,
      text(size: 11pt, weight: 700, color: accent)[DAY #day-num],
      text(size: 9pt, color: C-muted)[ #date],
      [],
    )
  }
  v(2pt)
  text(size: 18pt, weight: 800, color: C-navy)[#title]
  if subtitle != none {
    v(1pt)
    text(size: 10pt, color: C-muted)[#subtitle]
  }

  v(5pt)
  line(length: 100%, thickness: 0.5pt, color: C-muted.lighten(50%))
  v(7pt)

  let chip-items = ()
  for c in chips {
    chip-items.push(chip(c.at(0), c.at(1), c.at(2)))
  }

  grid(
    columns: (38%, 62%),
    column-gutter: 12pt,
    align: (top, top),
    timetable(times, events, accent),
    {
      body
      v(8pt)
      grid(columns: (auto, auto), column-gutter: 4pt, row-gutter: 3pt, ..chip-items)
    },
  )
}

#set page(
  paper: "a4",
  margin: (top: 1.4cm, bottom: 1.4cm, x: 1.8cm),
  background: none,
)

#set text(
  font: ("PingFang TC", "STSong", "Arial"),
  fallback: true,
  size: 10pt,
  color: C-text,
)

#set heading(numbering: "1.")
#show heading.where(level: 1): it => {
  v(14pt)
  text(size: 14pt, weight: 800, color: C-navy, it.body)
  v(4pt)
}

#show par: set block(spacing: 6pt)
#show strong: set text(weight: 700)

#let chip(label, val, accent) = box(
  radius: 5pt,
  inset: (x: 7pt, y: 2pt),
  fill: accent.lighten(88%),
)[#text(size: 8.5pt, weight: 700, fill: accent)[#label] #text(size: 8.5pt, fill: C-text)[#val]]

// hero image helper
#let hero-img(path, height: 6.5cm) = box(
  clip: true,
  radius: 6pt,
  width: 100%,
  height: height,
)[#image(path, width: 100%, height: 100%, fit: "cover")]

// color strip
#let strip(color) = box(width: 100%, height: 5pt, radius: 2.5pt, fill: color)

// rating badge
#let rating-badge(label) = box(
  radius: 4pt,
  inset: (x: 8pt, y: 3pt),
  fill: C-gold,
)[#text(size: 8.5pt, weight: 700, fill: C-navy)[#label]]

// timetable table helper
#let timetable(times, events, accent) = {
  let cells = ()
  cells.push(text(size: 8.5pt, weight: 700, fill: C-white)[時間])
  cells.push(text(size: 8.5pt, weight: 700, fill: C-white)[行程])
  for i in range(times.len()) {
    cells.push(text(size: 8.5pt, weight: 700, fill: accent)[#times.at(i)])
    cells.push(text(size: 9pt, fill: C-text)[#events.at(i)])
  }
  table(
    columns: (1.3cm, 1fr),
    inset: (x: 5pt, y: 4pt),
    stroke: (x, y) => if y == 0 { none } else { 0.3pt },
    fill: (x, y) => if calc.even(y) { C-light } else { C-white },
    align: (left, left),
    ..cells,
  )
}

  day-num,
  date,
  title,
  subtitle,
  accent,
  hero-path,
  hero-height,
  rating,
  chips,
  times,
  events,
  body,

  hero-img(hero-path, height: hero-height)
  v(5pt)
  strip(accent)
  v(5pt)

  if rating != none {
    grid(
      columns: (1fr, auto),
      column-gutter: 8pt,
      text(size: 11pt, weight: 700, color: accent)[DAY #day-num],
      text(size: 9pt, color: C-muted)[ #date],
      rating-badge(rating),
    )
  } else {
    grid(
      columns: (1fr, auto),
      column-gutter: 8pt,
      text(size: 11pt, weight: 700, color: accent)[DAY #day-num],
      text(size: 9pt, color: C-muted)[ #date],
      [],
    )
  }
  v(2pt)
  text(size: 18pt, weight: 800, color: C-navy)[#title]
  if subtitle != none {
    v(1pt)
    text(size: 10pt, color: C-muted)[#subtitle]
  }

  v(5pt)
  line(length: 100%, thickness: 0.5pt, color: C-muted.lighten(50%))
  v(7pt)

  let chip-items = ()
  for c in chips {
    chip-items.push(chip(c.at(0), c.at(1), c.at(2)))
  }

  grid(
    columns: (38%, 62%),
    column-gutter: 12pt,
    align: (top, top),
    timetable(times, events, accent),
    {
      body
      v(8pt)
      grid(columns: (auto, auto), column-gutter: 4pt, row-gutter: 3pt, ..chip-items)
    },
  )
}
